name: Stock Ticker
description: The stock exchange ticker symbol identifying the publicly traded company, e.g. AAPL, TSLA, MSFT.

name: Stock Name
description: The full legal or common name of the company whose stock is held.

name: Portfolio ID
description: The unique identifier for the portfolio that holds this stock position.

name: Shares Owned
description: The total number of shares currently held in the portfolio.

name: Purchase Price
description: The price per share at which the stock was originally purchased.

name: Purchase Price Currency
description: ISO 3 letter currency code for the purchase price, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP.

name: Current Price
description: The most recent market price per share for this stock.

name: Current Price Currency
description: ISO 3 letter currency code for the current price, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP.

name: Total Cost Basis
description: The total amount paid for all shares owned, calculated as sharesOwned multiplied by purchasePrice.

name: Total Market Value
description: The current total market value of the position, calculated as sharesOwned multiplied by currentPrice.

name: Purchase Date
description: The date on which the stock shares were originally purchased.

name: Sector
description: The industry sector classification of the company, e.g. Technology, Healthcare, Finance, Energy.

name: Dividend Yield
description: The annual dividend yield percentage for this stock.

name: Market Capitalization
description: The total market capitalization of the company in billions.

name: Daily Trading Volume
description: The average daily trading volume of shares.

name: 52-Week High
description: The highest trading price in the past 52 weeks.

name: 52-Week Low
description: The lowest trading price in the past 52 weeks.

name: Position Status
description: The current status of the stock position, e.g. held, sold, pending_buy, pending_sell.

name: Broker
description: The brokerage firm holding the stock position.

name: Account Type
description: The type of account holding the position, e.g. individual, joint, retirement, trust.

name: Gain or Loss
description: The unrealized gain or loss on the position, calculated as totalMarketValue minus totalCostBasis.

name: Gain or Loss Percentage
description: The unrealized gain or loss as a percentage of the total cost basis.

name: Holding Period (Days)
description: The number of days the stock has been held in the portfolio.
